pain_point: Published club directories can contain inactive organizations and dead links, undermining discovery.
severity_rationale: A directory that looks complete but is stale wastes search time and weakens trust in the whole engagement service.
source_context: Old Dominion student asked how to find active clubs because CampusGroups entries appeared inactive or broken.
prevalence_limitations: Single anonymous post at one institution; no prevalence estimate.

pain_point: Students can message listed club leaders through the platform or email and receive no response because organizations coordinate elsewhere.
severity_rationale: Non-response blocks joining and makes official listings less useful precisely when a prospective member needs a reliable contact.
source_context: Stanford students described CampusGroups messages and email going unanswered; commenters said many clubs did not use the platform.
prevalence_limitations: Small anonymous convenience sample from one campus; comments may overrepresent frustrated users.

pain_point: Mobile login loops and non-responsive event screens can block event discovery and attendance tasks.
workflow: Open the mobile app and view events
severity_rationale: Authentication or navigation failure prevents the student from reaching any downstream event function.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2023. Multiple iOS reviews described login failures, indefinite loading and event tiles that could not be opened; the developer replied to reports.
prevalence_limitations: Small self-selected set of public reviews; versions and institution configuration vary and reports may have been fixed.

pain_point: The mobile experience may expose less functionality than the web product.
severity_rationale: Parity gaps force staff back to a desktop and weaken adoption of a mobile-first workflow.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2020. A higher-education reviewer said the mobile app was less robust than the web experience.
prevalence_limitations: One dated vendor-referred review in a small review set; exact missing functions and current-version status are unknown.

pain_point: Conditional form logic has a learning curve for staff configuring workflows.
severity_rationale: Configuration friction raises setup time and the risk of routing or data-collection errors.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2022. A student-life reviewer specifically identified conditional logic setup as difficult to learn.
prevalence_limitations: Single vendor-referred review; no task-time measurement or prevalence estimate.

pain_point: Only the officer who starts a CampusGroups event draft can submit it for approval.
severity_rationale: A handoff, absence or officer change can strand a draft even when other officers can edit the event after publication.
source_context: Case Western Reserve University documents this as a platform limitation in its event-creation instructions.
prevalence_limitations: One institution's configured deployment; the constraint may vary by product version or permissions.

pain_point: Self-service QR check-in was unavailable in the documented Involve workflow, requiring a separate form and manual transfer of student IDs.
severity_rationale: The workaround adds reconciliation work and creates more opportunities for transcription or attribution errors.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2025-02. Modern Campus support described a form-plus-QR workaround and copying student IDs into the event attendance record.
prevalence_limitations: Point-in-time support answer; staff-scanned QR check-in exists, and the limitation may change in later releases.

pain_point: Officer turnover can erase process knowledge when outgoing leaders leave without training successors.
severity_rationale: Lost credentials, files, vendor context and institutional knowledge delay registration, events and funding work.
source_context: University of Northern Iowa warns that outgoing leaders sometimes leave without training; an older Georgia Tech assessment also identified leadership transition as a major organization challenge.
prevalence_limitations: The sources establish the failure mode at two institutions but do not quantify current national prevalence; one source is from 2016.

pain_point: Student-organization funding can require separate applications, hearings, revisions, approvals and post-event reports over several weeks.
severity_rationale: Long lead times and multiple handoffs can make funding the critical path for an event and penalize inexperienced officers.
source_context: University of Colorado Boulder documents separate applications by funding type, 8-30 day reviews, hearings, final approval and post-event reporting.
prevalence_limitations: Institution-specific process rather than a software defect; timing should not be generalized to every campus.

pain_point: Integrated campus data can arrive late enough that the portal does not feel live.
severity_rationale: One-to-two-hour delays can create mismatches in membership, access or activity state during operational workflows.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2024-01. A verified higher-education reviewer reported that Pathify data could lag by one to two hours.
prevalence_limitations: Single vendor-invited and incentivized review; the affected integration and configuration are unspecified.

pain_point: Calendar templates and widgets can be cumbersome to customize and may not let submitters preview their event before submission.
severity_rationale: Design mismatch and lack of preview create extra administrator review and make public pages harder to align with campus standards.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2023. Higher-education reviewers described painful template customization, visual mismatch and lack of a submitter preview.
prevalence_limitations: Small self-selected review sample; implementation skill and theme scope vary by institution.

pain_point: Initial consolidation of feeds, categories and campus stakeholders can be labor-intensive.
severity_rationale: Taxonomy and ownership work delays launch and can produce duplicate or miscategorized events when rushed.
source_context: Reported period (imprecise): 2024. A higher-education reviewer described setup as laborious because data feeds, categorization and stakeholder needs had to be consolidated.
prevalence_limitations: Single review; this is partly an institutional data-governance problem rather than product behavior alone.
